title: psbt-spec rules.json
description: Every declared entry of the specification (rules, guidance, definitions, procedures), generated by `render --json` from rust/src/spec.rs. See docs/rules.md.

status.description: Release status. Before 1.0, rule IDs may be renumbered, merged or removed.

revision.description: The package version, followed by the source commit in parentheses when rendered for publication.

corpora.description: The corpus files coverage is computed from.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root (and the published site).

bip_revision.description: The bitcoin/bips commit the file was labeled against.

vectors.description: Number of vectors in the file.

file.description: Corpus file name without extension, as in vectors/<file>.json.

index.description: Position in the file's vectors array, from 0.

id.description: Rule, procedure or guidance ID; the page anchor is #<id>. Empty for a definition, whose anchor is #term-<slug of topic>.

section.description: The section title: a General section (Framing, Structure, ...) or a role.

text.description: The normative wording, keeping the BIP's MUST, SHOULD or MAY.

coverage.description: How much of the statement the check decides. Null for entries that are not rules.

phase.description: For a role rule: checked on the PSBT the role received (Precondition) or returned (Result).

gates.description: Conditions under which the rule applies, such as a BIP being enabled.

checks.description: The reference functions bound to the rule.

gap.description: For a Partial rule, what its check leaves undecided.

role.description: For guidance, the role section it is shown with.

roles.description: For a General rule, the roles whose BIP text assigns its duty.

status.description: corpus: a vector isolates the rule. tests only: the rule has a check but no vector isolates it. none: no check.

isolating.description: Invalid vectors labeled with this rule that fail it alone.

passing.description: Valid vectors whose entry point observed the rule passing.
